subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the shipped multiline keys, or should OpenClaw also add a configurable TUI send/newline preference?
rationale: Basic multiline composition is already shipped, while configuration would create a durable public surface and compatibility obligation that cannot be inferred from the existing behavior.

options.title: Document shipped behavior
options.body: Add TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter without introducing configuration.

options.title: Add configurable send keys
options.body: Define and implement a narrow persisted or CLI preference with explicit terminal compatibility, conflict handling, and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Document shipped behavior
recommendation.body: Add TUI help and docs for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and backslash-Enter without introducing configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation history and prior issue review most directly connect this TUI product choice to him.
